name: Off-Highway Recreational Vehicle
description: A vehicle built for off-highway recreation: an ATV, a side-by-side, a snowmobile, or a motorcycle designed for off-highway use that can't be registered as a motorcycle, commonly known as a dirt bike. An off-road electric dirt bike lands here.

restrictions.rule: Includes a motorcycle designed for off-highway operation that isn't eligible for registration as a Class D (motorcycle) vehicle, with no limit on power or speed (Maryland Transportation Article §11-140.1)
One bought on or after October 1, 2010 must be titled with the MVA, applying electronically
Can't be registered for the road, so it may not be driven on a highway
